stem: What happens next in this passage after “Warmer water holds less oxygen and can stress some species.”?
options: The class suggested adding shade sails near the basketball court and planting trees along the fence.
After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road.
Before the class trip, Mr. Lee gave each student a small paper map.
The class planted small trees along a section of the river with permission from the city.
